title: Shipping and delivery
text:
# Shipping and delivery

## Delivery times

Orders placed before 2pm are roasted and shipped the next working day. Delivery within the UK takes two to three working days. Delivery to Ireland and the EU takes five to seven working days.

## Costs

Standard delivery is 4.95 GBP. Delivery is free on orders over 30 GBP. Next day delivery is 7.95 GBP and must be ordered before 2pm.

## Tracking

A tracking link is emailed when the parcel leaves the roastery. If tracking says delivered and nothing arrived, contact us within seven days and we will investigate with the carrier.

title: Returns and refunds
text:
# Returns and refunds

## Unopened bags

Any unopened bag can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. You pay return postage unless the item was faulty.

## Damaged or faulty items

If a bag arrives split, crushed or otherwise damaged, we replace it free of charge. Send a photo within 14 days of delivery and we will post a replacement the same day. You do not need to return the damaged bag.

## Refund timing

Refunds are returned to the original payment method and take three to five working days to appear.

## What we cannot refund

Engraved items and personalised gift sets are made to order and cannot be refunded unless faulty.

title: Subscriptions
text:
# Subscriptions

## Pausing

You can pause a subscription for up to three months from the account page. Pausing before the roast date means you are not charged for that cycle.

## Changing frequency

Subscriptions ship every two, four or six weeks. Change the frequency at any time; it takes effect from the next cycle.

## Cancelling

Cancel at any time with no notice period and no fee. Cancelling after the roast date means the final order still ships and is still charged.

## Discount

Subscribers save 10 percent on every order and get free delivery regardless of order value.

title: The coffee
text:
# The coffee

## Ethiopia Guji

A washed Ethiopian coffee with notes of peach, bergamot and jasmine. Roasted light. Best as filter or pour over.

## House blend

A medium roast of Brazilian and Colombian beans. Chocolate and hazelnut. Works in espresso, moka pot and cafetiere.

## Grind

We grind to order. For a French press choose coarse, for a moka pot choose fine, for filter choose medium. Whole bean keeps its flavour longest.

## Freshness

Bags are best within four weeks of roasting and within two weeks of opening. Keep the bag sealed, out of the fridge, away from light.

title: Your account
text:
# Your account

## Signing in

If you cannot sign in, use the reset link on the sign in page. The email arrives within a few minutes; check the spam folder before writing to us.

## Changing your details

Update your delivery address, billing email and card from the account page. Changes to a delivery address apply to orders that have not yet shipped.

## Deleting your account

Ask us to delete your account and we remove your order history and personal details within 30 days. Invoices are kept for seven years because tax law requires it.

title: Wholesale
text:
# Wholesale

## Minimum order

Wholesale starts at 20kg per month. Below that, the subscription discount is the better price.

## Pricing

Wholesale pricing is quoted per origin and depends on volume. Email wholesale@lumen.example with the volume and origins you want.

## Delivery

Wholesale orders are delivered on pallets, on a day agreed with you, and are not sent through the normal carrier.
